intro: Ebony is designed for modern meals and timeless conversations. With a sturdy base, and rich dark wood, it’s built to look elegant and live well.

features.title: Extended back for ultimate relaxation
features.text: Enjoy exceptional comfort with the extended backrest, designed to provide support and relaxation during long meals or gatherings.

features.title: A curve that feels natural
features.text: The ergonomic backrest supports your posture gently, following the shape of your spine for all-day ease.

features.title: Comfort with quiet class
features.text: With its neutral leatherette seat and sculpted form, our chair blends in while standing tall.

features.title: Strength that doesn’t shout
features.text: Built with strong, powder-coated legs, this chair combines durability with sleek modern style, seamlessly fitting into your home’s aesthetic.

features.title: Built to be wiped, not scrubbed
features.text: Smooth upholstery and simple lines make cleaning easy—perfect for homes that live fully.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
